login.title: Sign in to Tallyvane
login.lead: Your job search, on the record. New here? The same button creates your account.
login.fineprint: We only use Google to confirm who you are. Tallyvane never sees your Google password.
login.failed: We couldn't reach Google just now. Try again in a moment.
login.problemRestart: That sign-in took a wrong turn. Start again, please.
login.problemExpired: That sign-in took too long and timed out. Start again, please.
login.problemCancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
login.problemRefused: Google didn't let us confirm who you are. Try again, or use another Google account.
login.problemEmailUnverified: Google hasn't verified that email address, so we can't use it. Verify it with Google, or use another account.
login.problemUnavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

continue.title: Signing you in
continue.failed: We couldn't finish signing you in.
continue.closeTab: You're signed in. You can close this tab.

welcome.title: Welcome to Tallyvane
welcome.signedInAs: Signed in with Google as {email}. One more step.
welcome.name: Your name

welcome.nameInvalid: Enter the name you'd like us to use.
welcome.failed: We couldn't create your account. Try again in a moment.

reauth.title: Your session expired
reauth.lead: Sign in again to continue. Your unsaved work is still here, and we'll finish saving it right after.
reauth.different: Signing in as a different person will discard these changes.
